task.title: Backfill past value snapshots so reports never call GitHub
task.description:
## Why
Trade history prices old trades with the values from the week of each trade. The CLI gets those by reading the DynastyProcess repo's commit history through the GitHub API, which allows 60 anonymous calls an hour. That cannot sit in the path of a user request.

## Steps
1. Write a one-off script that lists every commit of `files/values.csv`, downloads each version and uploads it to R2 as a dated snapshot. Follow `snapshot_index` in `rebuild/trade_history.py`.
2. Run it with a GitHub token so it is not throttled.
3. Write the snapshot index in the same format the daily job maintains.
4. Keep the script in the repo. It runs again when moving to the team account.

## Done when
- R2 holds a snapshot for every past commit of the values file, and one index covers them and the daily ones.
- Building a report makes no calls to GitHub.
